indexer/UI; reads chain and protocol registries
portable domain-specific evidence and reputation-signal protocol; exposes authenticated per-metric history and aggregates without creating a universal social or credit score
community and organization coordination protocol; canonicalizes Spaces, membership, capability-scoped authority, roles, channels, invites and policies while keeping message/media payloads off-chain

public social graph, publishing and discovery-reference protocol; canonicalizes portable profiles, follows/blocks, publication provenance, append-only revisions, topics and lightweight interactions while keeping feed ranking, recommendation and media payloads non-canonical

programmable custody, escrow, reserve and beneficiary protocol with capability-scoped authority, obligation-aware collateral accounting, replay-safe release paths and non-confiscatory lifecycle controls; user products such as 420Stash, 420Cure and 420Legacy are policy profiles over the shared primitive

decentralized encrypted-routing and bandwidth protocol; chain state governs provider/node identity, bounded session authorization, route/pricing commitments, receipt settlement and staking/trust references while encrypted packet transport, endpoint discovery and traffic contents remain off-chain
universal marketplace protocol; references canonical asset/right registries and approved settlement adapters instead of taking custody
provider-neutral external-data protocol with freshness, quorum, confidence, deviation, replay and circuit-breaker controls; randomness remains a separately routed service

constitutional decision and collective-action protocol for 420 Integrated. GovernanceTimelock at 0x0429 and Governance420 at 0x0437 remain frozen Genesis compatibility/predeploy identities while Civic modules provide explicit proposal classes, immutable action commitments, constitutional thresholds, lifecycle rules and future electorate/voting adapters.

distributed AI application/protocol layer for canonical model identity, immutable model versions, provider deployments, AI request/result commitments and AI-specific verification/privacy semantics; actual accelerator execution is off-chain and general compute procurement/settlement is delegated to the shared 420 ComputeMarket. Existing 0x042f-0x0433 AI predeploy identities remain frozen compatibility/discovery surfaces and must be hardened rather than deleted or silently repurposed.

shared general-purpose decentralized market for off-chain CPU/GPU/accelerator/proving/rendering/simulation/batch compute; canonicalizes resource capability, offers, bounded requests, immutable accepted matches, strict job lifecycles, receipts, verification profiles and Vault-backed settlement. It is consumed by 420AI but remains usable by non-AI workloads. No new frozen predeploy address is allocated by this architecture.
